1110_2022.as_if_always: Yes, by cells, no wording. The gross development table (p37, heading 'Gross insurance contract outstanding claims provision as at 31 December 2022', intro p36: 'The following tables show the estimates of cumulative incurred claims, including both claims notified and IBNR for each successive underwriting year at each reporting date') shows full diagonals for the acquired 2018 and 2019 underwriting years: 2018 column 44,984 / 100,979 / 105,633 / 113,604 / 115,426 (end of UY, 12, 24, 36, 48 months) and 2019 column 104,174 / 184,687 / 225,235 / 199,843 (end of UY, 12, 24, 36 months), although the syndicate took these years on only in 2022 (p33). Each acquired year therefore appears with its whole prior history. No sentence says the history is restated or 'as if always'. The note beside the table says only: '2021 Year of account has not been presented above as the Syndicate did not participate on this year of account.' The p8 line 'The 2019 and 2020 years of account have reinsured into the 2022 year of account' is a post-year-end item (2019/2020 are also separate columns, so which of these columns are own years and which acquired is not printed beyond the p33 sentence naming 5678's 2018 and 2019 years).

latest_less_previous_diagonal_by_column_.note: 2021 column not presented; sum is from the printed cells, GBP m (e.g. 2019: 199,843 less 225,235; 2020: 123,833 less 104,712). This is the table-as-printed movement, which includes pre-acquisition development of the acquired 2018/2019 years (2018: +1.822, 2019: -25.392, net -23.570).

1110_2022.adc_direction: INWARD for the Hiscox ADC: Syndicate 1110 is the reinsurer of Hiscox's Syndicates 33 and 3624 (p5 'the ADC of certain years of account of Syndicates 33 and 3624 ... managed by Hiscox'; p5 principal activity: 'the transaction of reinsurance business ... by way of reinsurance to close ("RITC"), loss portfolio transfer ("LPT") or adverse development cover ("ADC")'; p35 'The Syndicate now issues reinsurance contracts in the United Kingdom by way of reinsurance to close ("RITC"), loss portfolio transfer ("LPT") or adverse development cover ("ADC")'; p32 'Reinsurance accepted' creditors 4,248 + 29,294). Hiscox ADC premium is part of gross written premium 333,442. The Gibson Re 80% whole account quota share is OUTWARD (p5; p15 outward reinsurance premiums (249,826); reinsurers' share of claims outstanding 274,249 at p27), so the reinsurer's share is not a deduction from the gross take-on.

takeon_base_m.basis: cannot be computed from printed figures because the transferred gross amount is not printed
takeon_base_m.proxy_upper: opening 221.885 + GWP 333.442 = 555.327 (GWP also includes any ordinary business and Gibson-ceded premium is not netted since gross); another bound: closing 489.603 is after paying 99.706
takeon_base_m.comparison: analysis opening 221.885 equals opening gross claims outstanding (p27) exactly, so it does NOT include any acquired reserves. The true take-on base is materially higher than 221.885 (the closing is 489.603 and the 2022 gross written premium of 333.442 is dominated by the two deals), but its size is not stated in the filing.

1110_2022.note: The filing states that the two deals happened and that they drove premium, claims incurred, assets and reserves (p6: 'Investments, gross technical reserves and reinsurer' share of technical provisions have increased significantly as a consequence'), but gives no figure for the claims outstanding assumed. The mature-cohort table movement 9.082m sits against an opening R of 221.885 that excludes the acquired book; the acquired 2018 and 2019 columns carry pre-acquisition development (net -23.570m). Recommend treating the record as a take-on with unknown base unless the 5678 filing (not in the corpus: no syndicate_5678_2021 file) or the 2022 RITC schedule can be found.
